title: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated course…
description: ClassroomIO versions up to 1.0.0 have an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access and manipulate newsfeed posts belonging to other tenants by using a foreign feedId with their own courseId. This flaw enables unauthorized reading, reacting, commenting, and, for team members or organization admins, overwriting, pinning, and deleting cross-organization posts.
